|game_text=Deploy on [[Yavin 4 (V) (Virtual Block 7){{!}}Yavin 4]]. Once per turn, may deploy a battleground system or an interior Yavin 4 site. If total destiny > 6, stack top card from either player's Reserve Deck there (limit one per system) to 'liberate' the system. At 'liberated' systems: Force drains are +1, and at same and related locations your total power is +3 and you draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile.
